text.what: Cutting unripe bunches onto the ground in summer so the vine ripens fewer. Yield control with secateurs, after the vine has already set more fruit than the grower wants.
text.how: Pinot crops generously if allowed to; appellation rules cap yield, and growers who want concentration cut below the cap. Done too late, the remaining berries just get bigger.

kin.as: Where the yield caps are written into the appellation.
The other way to make each vine carry less.
